svg.text: Blue: runs in flight minute by minute. Red: λ·W = 14.79 runs/hour × 6.1 min = 1.5. Dashed blue: the area under the blue curve over 24 h, 1.5, the same number. That is Little's law,
L = λW: the time-average number in a system equals the arrival rate times the mean time spent in it, for any arrival pattern and any service-time distribution, because both sides
count the same run-minutes. Orange: each hour's λ·W (its own arrivals and their durations), which follows the blue curve only roughly: over a window not much longer than W,
runs carry load into the next hour.
